state_source: preset/tone/motion/volume; active renderer clock; native scroll progress. Audio and shape derive from the same preset.

composition.short_height: below 620px natural page growth instead of compressed or overlapping content

native_scroll.geometry: layer center scale + progress*layer*0.035, width*(1-progress*0.08), binormal separation*(layer-1)*progress*0.12
native_scroll.after_arrival: follow actual native/sticky instrument slot rect
native_scroll.controls: above overlay in dedicated non-overlapping design zones; browser QA pending
native_scroll.mobile: dedicated stacked sticky instrument visual zone
native_scroll.reduced_or_paused: immediately use slot nearest viewport center, no interpolated travel

pause.raf: one pending/explicit input frame then no continuous RAF

visibility.hidden: cancel graphics RAF; cancel pending audio resume by generation; stop/dispose audio; no automatic sound restart
visibility.pagehide: also clear UI timer, cancel pending placement frame, invalidate offline/export/import results
visibility.pageshow: restore UI timer and graphics; audio remains stopped

resize.canvas: slot bounds with fixed maximum-slot drawing buffer; DPR <=1.6 desktop /1.35 phone
resize.mesh: mobile segments selected on initial load

fallback.no_webgl: original preset-specific SVG + functional sound controls

diagnostics.performance: 20-second actual active frame intervals, LCP and max-session CLS; unsupported=null
